references.text: Describes the sabbatical year (shmita) that was to be observed every seventh year, when debts were to be forgiven
Gives instructions about the Feast of Tabernacles (Sukkot) that Israel was to celebrate
The commandment regarding the Feast of Tabernacles in the seventh month
The laws concerning the sabbatical year, where the land was to rest every seventh year
Ezra reads the Law to the people during the Feast of Tabernacles, fulfilling the commandment to read the Law
Continuation of the commandment explaining that the Law is to be read to all Israel during the Feast of Tabernacles
